body:
Ziggy agreed to one Lisan character-look reference board first, using existing sources. This is the bounded candidate-inventory step for that board, separate from V1 calibration and the already accepted active-run copy request.

Please inventory existing candidates for natural face/neck marks, signature outfit, optional breather with natural teeth/no grill, optional grill design, and body build. Give exact current source path, canonical ID where present, full SHA256/bytes/version, visible angle/limitations and any existing selection evidence. Preserve source-reported history, retained human-selection observations, and exact human ledger records as separate evidence classes. Supply candidates only; do not make new creative selections, grades or production acceptance.

Our completed audit already finds:
- Face/marks: LAG-602a9fd4021dc356, LAG-LOCK-FACE-NATURAL.jpg; current identity nomination and lisan-face/ink criteria; Chief-reported selection history, direct exact human approval record not located.
- Outfit: LAG-63126392af1ccf8b, LAG-LOOK-V3-01.jpg; current outfit-only nomination, Chief-reported favorite.
- Optional breather/natural/no-grill: LAG-PART-1b60815fa2bb, v3; retained observation of Ziggy's actual combination selection, not default.
- Optional grill: LAG-cb183973ed1fc70e, historical LAG-LOCK-FACE.jpg; exact human Keep/detailed-design record, dental-design scope only, natural teeth default.
- Body build: LAG500-L01-V2 is an existing candidate only. No accepted Lisan physique target located. The proposed minus-one rule remains unverified.

The linked checkpoint contains exact file/hash/provenance details. Confirm existing evidence or identify missing/conflicting candidates; do not request repeat approvals for settled scoped selections merely because a criteria sidecar is absent. Site Index retains all site code/data/build ownership and will present one board using the existing index method. PA reconciles approval history; Ziggy only resolves missing/conflicting choices.

No generation, new canon, source promotion, site edits by Chief, grading, key comparison, V1 rerun or packet changes. Do not resend/restart the active V1 run or its already accepted copy request. Preserve its frozen v001; any future correction is separately versioned. This message is posted to the mailbox only; receipt/read and execution remain unverified.
